description: The ownership and usage-annotation suite, Phase 1 part (MT.7): each annotated program ix accepts, written with ix's contract syntax, with its plain twin (the annotated source with the contract atoms deleted), and the plain-only erasure and allocation fixtures. tests-own pairs the twins; ix's verdicts on the annotated sources it rejects are in verdicts.json.

producer.ix: the ix of this repository: lake build ix at the repository root, in its dev shell (not a Nix build)

roots.name: entry
roots.note: `n < 5` is `Nat.decLt`, i.e. `n + 1 ≤ 5`, so `n = 2⁶³ − 1` fails with status 3 at the word levels although nothing exceeds a word (MT.2 finding 4)
